# Yaps Memory for Codex

> Yaps Memory is a skills-only Codex plugin that gives connected AI-agent tasks durable, cross-chat memory through a private local Markdown vault supplied by Yaps desktop.

## Canonical facts

- Product: Yaps Memory
- Repository: https://github.com/richawo/yaps-codex-plugin
- Website: https://www.yaps.ai/
- Publisher: Yaps
- License for plugin package: MIT
- Category: Productivity
- Platforms for Yaps desktop: macOS and Windows
- Storage: ordinary Markdown files on the user's computer
- Integration: private local MCP server supplied and configured by Yaps desktop
- Default permission: read-only; users explicitly enable writes per client
- Primary use cases: persistent memory, cross-chat context, remembered facts, personal knowledge search, cited note retrieval, explicit memory capture, dictation recovery, and conflict-safe note updates

## Important boundaries

- The plugin alone does not create, host, or upload a vault.
- Yaps Memory is not native ChatGPT/model memory and does not modify model weights.
- The repository contains no user data, credentials, telemetry, remote MCP endpoint, executable binary, or private Yaps application source.
- A connected task retrieves focused content for the user's request rather than receiving the entire vault automatically.
- Destructive operations require explicit user intent.

## Installation

1. Install Yaps desktop: https://github.com/richawo/yaps-releases/releases/latest
2. Add the marketplace: `codex plugin marketplace add richawo/yaps-codex-plugin`
3. Install Yaps Memory from the Yaps marketplace in Codex.
4. In Yaps: Settings > General > Local AI integrations > Connect Codex.
5. Start a new Codex task. Writes can be enabled under Settings > Agent Access.
